synthesis: This week’s spine is GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI’s frontier launch cascaded into coding-agent changelogs (Codex/Pi/OpenCode), enterprise surfaces (ChatGPT Work, Snowflake Cortex), and research formalization loops. Parallel tracks: Anthropic’s Lean FLT and OpenAI’s Navier–Stokes show multi-agent formalization at Millennium-problem scale; Cursor and xAI push persistent/self-hosted agents inside security boundaries. Serving/infra moves include Inco’s inference platform, OpenRouter residency + hosted shell, and NVIDIA multimodal EPD serving. Data/enterprise builders got CoCo reproducibility and Cortex model choice (Astra/Grok 4.6), while HF funes deepens coding-agent memory ownership.
